# Yellowback parameters

<!-- GENERATED by `ybcal params doc` from src/ybcal/params/registry.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every field of `yellowback::Params` (`src/yellowback/params.h`) and the `params.h` constants the rules read, at ycash6 commit `7702d22` (branch `feature/yellowback`). Mainnet is `SetCommon()` + `MainParams()` in `src/yellowback/params.cpp`; regtest is `RegtestParams()` with the six regtest flags at their defaults: `startHeight=1`, `sigmaRefBps=0`, `supplyCapBps=0`, `enforceUntilHeight=0`, `attestArmMin=3`, `bundleCarrier=SCRIPTSIG`. `ybcal params check` re-extracts both columns from source and fails on any difference.

## Classes

| Class | Meaning | How a change ships |
|---|---|---|
| locked | consensus-shaped among enforcing miners (K10) | new parameter set keyed by start height (L8; W19 freeze-then-fix) |
| excluded | informational, wallet default (L6), wallet/agent policy or node-local | patch release |
| per-release | `startHeight`, `enforceUntilHeight` (M14, L8) | every release; derived from the tip |
| constant | protocol constant | verified, never tuned |
| derived | fixed by a formula from a parent; locked when a rule reads it | follows its parent |
| meta | identity (network name, address version) | not calibrated |

Counts: locked 67, excluded 9, per-release 2, derived 7, constant 10, meta 2; total 97.

Hashed (in the state-hash `ParamsRecord`, `view.h`): `startHeight`, `enforceUntilHeight`, `supplyCapBps`, `sigmaRefBps`, `attestArmMin`, `bundleCarrier`.

## Invariants (PLAN §1.4)

Checked on every candidate before simulation (`ybcal.params.invariants`). *Mainnet-scale* checks are skipped for regtest-scale sets; *proposed* checks come from the plan, not a node rule.

| Invariant | Rule | Check | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_fill_fast` | L9 | pFastMinFill = ceil(pFastWindow / 2) | all |
| `min_fill_mid_slow` | L9 | pMid/pSlowMinFill = ceil(2W / 3) | all |
| `window_order` | PRICE-1 | pFastWindow < pMidWindow < pSlowWindow | all |
| `activation_order` | spec:481 (ACT-4/ACT-6) | enforcementFloor < participationFloor <= enforcementResume < activationThreshold <= signalWindow | all |
| `abandon_ge_grace` | W21 | abandonBlocks >= grace | all |
| `abandon_ge_runbook` | PLAN §5.4 (W19, M14) | abandonBlocks >= freeze-then-fix runbook length | mainnet-scale, proposed |
| `start_configured` | M2 | startHeight >= 1 | all |
| `sunset` | L8 (ACT-5) | enforceUntilHeight = startHeight + BLOCKS_PER_YEAR, never past the next network upgrade (0 = no sunset, regtest only) | all |
| `release_lead` | M14 | startHeight >= release tip + 16,128 (checked when a tip is given) | mainnet-scale |
| `regtest_zero_meanings` | M13 / spec §3.1 | sigmaRefBps, supplyCapBps, attestArmMin > 0 at mainnet scale (0 has a regtest-only meaning) | mainnet-scale |
| `class_contiguous` | MINT-2 (V19), H-5 | contiguous or empty: classMin[0] >= 1 and class A is non-empty; a class with classMin[i] > classMax[i] is disabled (H-5); the non-empty classes, in order, satisfy classMin[next] = classMax[prev] + 1 | all |
| `class_locktime` | MINT-2 / CLTV | max(classMax of the enabled classes) + grace + tip < 500,000,000 | all |
| `vol_step_divides` | SIGMA-1 | volWindow % volStep == 0 | all |
| `vol_periods` | K13 | volPeriodsPerYear = BLOCKS_PER_YEAR / volStep exactly (mainnet scale); 8,760 on regtest | all |
| `base_gt_halt` | HALT-2 / MINT-5, H-11 | baseRatioBps[i] > globalRatioHaltBps for every enabled class (a disabled class mints nothing) | all |
| `recap_double` | W16 | recapRatioBps = 2 × globalRatioHaltBps | all |
| `claim_emergency_order` | RED-4 | claimThresholdBps > emergencyRatioBps > 10,000 | all |
| `bundle_size` | BUNDLE-1 | mSelect + kSlack <= bundleMax <= 6 and nSlots >= mSelect + kSlack | all |
| `quantile_sum` | bundle statistic | qLowBps + qHighBps = 10,000 | all |
| `qlow_vs_entity` | PLAN §5.8 (capture) | qLowBps > the largest single-entity weight share assumed | all, proposed |
| `attest_max_age` | R4 | attestMaxAge = 2 × attestInterval | all |
| `emergency_persist_lt_ttl` | NOT-1 | emergencyPersist < emergencyNoticeTtl | all |
| `bond_lock_year` | REG-A1 | bondMinLock = BLOCKS_PER_YEAR | mainnet-scale |
| `age_cap_u32` | bond weight | 0 < ageCap < 2^32 | all |
| `amount_order` | MINT-2 / XFER-1 | minOutput <= minMint <= maxMint <= maxOutput | all |
| `fee_floor_mintable` | MINT-5 | 4·feeMin <= collateral of a minMint vault at the worst covered price | all |
| `protocol_constants` | params.h | tokenValue = TOKEN_VALUE, refWindow = REF_WINDOW | all |
